blocks.text: I’m obsessed with buffalo sauce! My first Whole30 back in 2017 sparked that love, so when I call this pasta salad a top pick for game‑day snacks, barbecues, or even a random Tuesday, I truly mean it. It captures everything I adore about buffalo wings without the sticky fingers. It can serve as an appetizer, side, or a full meal depending on how you pile it on. I love pairing it with my buffalo turkey meatballs, and it also goes great with fried shrimp for a quick weeknight dinner.

blocks.html:
1. Cook pasta until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
2. While that's cooking, dice up your celery, bell pepper, and green onion.
3. Whisk together ranch, buffalo sauce, dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste. Want more heat? Add it.
4. In a big [bowl](https://amzn.to/3FVhA1Q), combine the pasta and veggies, then pour the dressing on and toss until everything is coated.
5. Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.
blocks.heading: ## Step by step
blocks.content: - Cook pasta until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside. - While that's cooking, dice up your celery, bell pepper, and green onion. - Whisk together ranch, buffalo sauce, dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste. Want more heat? Add it. - In a big bowl, combine the pasta and veggies, then pour the dressing on and toss until everything is coated. - Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipe.name: Buffalo Ranch Protein Pasta Salad
recipe.summary: This Buffalo Ranch Protein Pasta Salad is creamy, spicy, and loaded with fresh crunch. A gluten free, high protein side dish that's perfect for meal prep or parties.

ingredient_groups.name: Dressing
items: ⅓ cup ranch *I use Primal Kitchen's Ranch to keep this dairy free
3 tablespoons buffalo sauce *I use Frank's Original Hot Sauce

instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
While that's cooking, dice up your celery, bell pepper, and green onion.
Whisk together ranch, buffalo sauce, dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste. Want more heat? Add some more buffalo sauce.
In a big bowl , combine the pasta and veggies, then pour the dressing on and toss until everything is coated.
Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.

sections.html:
1. Cook pasta until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
2. While that's cooking, dice up your celery, bell pepper, and green onion.
3. Whisk together ranch, buffalo sauce, dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste. Want more heat? Add it.
4. In a big [bowl](https://amzn.to/3FVhA1Q), combine the pasta and veggies, then pour the dressing on and toss until everything is coated.
5. Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.
sections.heading: ## Step by step
sections.content: - Cook pasta until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside. - While that's cooking, dice up your celery, bell pepper, and green onion. - Whisk together ranch, buffalo sauce, dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste. Want more heat? Add it. - In a big bowl, combine the pasta and veggies, then pour the dressing on and toss until everything is coated. - Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.
